# ECDSA

    Inspired by https://github.com/ZenGo-X/multi-party-ecdsa

## Distributed

### Manager 
    
For the tss instance exchange the data, and generate the party signup.

#### party signup
  
Generate the party signup

##### ***POST* Party Signup**

> /ecdsa/management/signup-party

##### **Request Body**

|Name|Type| Required | Description|
| :----------: | :----------: | :----------: | :----------: |
| key | string | yes | the room id for the consensus, should be unique |
| num | int | yes | Number of signup participants |

##### Example
###### Request
```shell
curl --location --request POST 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/ecdsa/management/signup-party' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
    "key": "5f3ceb01-cb0d-4fcf-ab7f-2df64b165f75",
    "num": 3
}'
```
###### Response
```shell
{
    "number": 1,
    "uuid": "d9e02e8b-e0d8-4ee1-823d-90c1025b0449"
}
```

#### Get entry
  
  Get the exchange data of signed participants

##### ***POST* Get entry**

> /ecdsa/management/get-entry

##### **Request Body**

|Name|Type| Required | Description|
| :----------: | :----------: | :----------: | :----------: |
| key | string | yes | should be unique |

##### Example
###### Request
```shell
curl --location --request POST 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/ecdsa/management/get-entry' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
    "key": "5f3ceb01-cb0d-4fcf-ab7f-2df64b165f75"
}'
```
###### Response
```shell
{
    "key": "5f3ceb01-cb0d-4fcf-ab7f-2df64b165f75",
    "value": "5f3ceb01-cb0d-4fcf-ab7f-2df64b165f75"
}

```
#### Set entry
  
  Store the exchange data for signed participants

##### ***POST* set entry**

> /ecdsa/management/set-entry

##### **Request Body**

|Name|Type| Required | Description|
| :----------: | :----------: | :----------: | :----------: |
| key | string | yes | should be unique |
| value | string | yes | store data |

##### Example
###### Request
```shell
curl --location --request POST 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/ecdsa/management/signup-party' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
    "key": "5f3ceb01-cb0d-4fcf-ab7f-2df64b165f75",
    "value": "5f3ceb01-cb0d-4fcf-ab7f-2df64b165f75"
}'
```
###### Response
```shell
{
    "key": "5f3ceb01-cb0d-4fcf-ab7f-2df64b165f75",
    "value": "5f3ceb01-cb0d-4fcf-ab7f-2df64b165f75"
}
```

### tss server 
    
Keygen and Sign

#### keygen
  
Generate party key

##### ***POST* sign party**

> /ecdsa/distributed/sign

##### **Request Body**

|Name|Type| Required | Description|
| :----------: | :----------: | :----------: | :----------: |
| threshold | int | yes | the room id for the consensus, should be unique |
| parties | int | yes | Number of signup participants |

##### Example
###### Request
```shell
curl --location --request POST 'http://10.0.152.113:28000//ecdsa/distributed/sign' \
--header 'token: 6382d2f5-ac5c-4d25-ba5f-54d14948eb9e' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
    "threshold": 1,
    "parties": 3
}'
```

## centralized

### TSS Server

Gen keys and Sign

#### keygen

Generate party keys

##### ***POST* Signup party keys**

> /ecdsa/centralized/keys

##### **Request Body**

|Name|Type| Required | Description|
| :----------: | :----------: | :----------: | :----------: |
| threshold | int | yes | the room id for the consensus, should be unique |
| parties | int | yes | Number of signup participants |

##### Example
###### Request
```shell
curl --location --request POST 'http://10.0.152.113:18000/ecdsa/centralized/keys' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
    "threshold": 2,
    "parties": 4
}'
```

#### sign

Sign message

##### ***POST* Sign message**

> /ecdsa/distributed/sign

##### **Request Body**

|Name|Type| Required | Description|
| :----------: | :----------: | :----------: | :----------: |
| threshold | int | yes | the room id for the consensus, should be unique |
| parties | int | yes | Number of signup participants |
